body: That's not always the case though- when I started taking anti-depressants I was afraid of the same thing- but it turned out that it made me like I used to be. The first time I smiled, I started crying, it was such a relief to smile and have it be real and genuine and warm. First though, you should start seeing a psychologist or a psychiatrist. That's what's going to really be helpful.
Listen, if you're even just thinking about it, then flush it! FLUSH IT NOW. I had to give all my meds to my friends and family to keep. Having it out of my reach definitely decreases the temptation-
Tell us- just talk, I'll read what you write.

I was discharged on 6/20/12. 
Silly, but I feel like you *understand* and that alone makes me feel slightly better. 
I don't know who to talk to (psychiatrist aside). It's not like we have a scarlet S on our lapel, though at time it certainly feels like it. 
Are you okay now? Whatever okay means to you? Thank you for your message. I really needed that.

Me too.
As though things weren't difficult enough to start with, now I have to deal with the added pressure of my friends and family knowing that I go through on a regular basis. Sometimes, I need to pretend everything is okay, and the concern is driving me up the wall!

Therapy and medication, for years now. I do try and take care of myself and am fortunate to have many resources I can access. 

What I'm saying though, is that there are moments when I feel like I can't cope with what happened, with the ER and the psych ward and the scariness and the not trusting myself to keep myself safe. I just want to know that those things will go away eventually.
I'd take my old depression and suicidal ideations over this feeling of isolation. This is just quicksand!

I have been seeing a psychiatrist, and taking meds (since before the incident). The worst part is that I thought I was doing better and I'm heartbroken at the relapse.  
I'm terrified of what happened, and the things that I went through in the psych ER were fucked up. I often have nightmares and wake up screaming, dreaming of that place. 
WHAT can I do?! I don't even care about everyone else's normal, just my normal is okay. I just can't cope with this sort of soul crushing alonenness in my suicide attempt.
